newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino says to sell HK flats at low prices.
newsitem.headline: Sino says to sell HK flats at low prices.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd will sell 28 flats in luxury residential development Dynasty View in Hong Kong's Tai Po for an average price of HK$4,880 per square foot, a statement issued for the developer said on Wednesday.
Located at the top of Tai Po South mid-levels in the New Territories, the development comprises six residential blocks.
The average price in the coming sale is below the current second-hand market price for luxury apartments in the same district, the statement said.
The 28 flats for sale range from 590 to 1,165 square feet in size.
Registration for intending buyers takes place on December 16, the statement said.
